Senior Software Engineer, Developer Platform

Our platform team makes every engineer faster.

What you'll do
- Build self-service infrastructure-as-code libraries and golden paths that cut service setup time.
- Own CI/CD and deployment tooling used by many teams and services.
- Consolidate deployment pipelines while keeping services independently scalable.
- Drive adoption across teams and keep older pipelines upgradable with backward compatibility.
- Automate production-readiness reviews before peak events.

Qualifications
- Experience with AWS CDK, CloudFormation or Terraform.
- Experience with Docker and container orchestration (ECS or Kubernetes).
- Experience building internal developer platforms or tooling.

Bonus
- Experience with Backstage or Spinnaker.
